verdict.rationale: Granola documents that it works with Zoom, Google Meet and Teams by capturing computer audio without a bot. Users start transcription from a calendar notification, and it detects call end or can be stopped manually, so capture is user-controlled. Granola transcribes rather than keeps recordings, and the evidence never shows saved audio or video recordings or where they would be stored. missing for 10: evidence of actual audio/video recording retention or storage location, per-platform depth documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of reliable capture across Zoom/Meet/Teams.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it

citations.quote: Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and every other meeting app.
Uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot
Open your Granola note for that meeting, and start transcribing
Once Granola has recognised your call has ended, or you stop it manually, it will automatically generate enhanced notes.
